entities.name: Q6BKL7 Set1
observations: Reviewed Debaryomyces hansenii Set1 protein; sequence match was 100% identity with 100% query coverage (Swiss-Prot local reference).
Catalytic component of COMPASS/Set1C; reference annotation states it mono-, di-, and trimethylates histone H3 Lys4, yielding H3K4me1/2/3.
Reference localization is nucleus and chromosome; component of Set1C/COMPASS complex.
Sequence Pfam hits: SET1_RBD (residues 251–338) and SET_assoc (438–503).
Sequence length 768 aa; estimated molecular mass 87,236 Da and pI 9.10.

entities.name: Set1C COMPASS
observations: Chromatin-associated complex containing Set1; mediates histone H3 Lys4 methylation. Reference annotation notes H2B ubiquitination stimulates H3 methylation.
